newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent drifts at higher levels, awaits NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent drifts at higher levels, awaits NYMEX.

text.p: IPE oil futures drifted in thin trade at higher levels at midday on Thursday, awaiting the NYMEX opening for wont of another source of direction, traders said.
December Brent was trading 23 cents higher at $23.80 a barrel at 1306 GMT, while November gas oil was $2.25 up at $219.50 a tonne.
"It's up but volumes are very light. We need to see higher volumes to confirm today's gains," one trader said.

Traders said Brent had been given some encouragement by news that Statoil's 250,000 barrels per day Heidrun field had halted production due to the loss its flare tip. "It helped a bit but it didn't have any great effect," said one trader.
November gas oil oscillated around the $219.50 level.
"It's very boring," said one trader. "The market needs some physical takeoff or bad weather to give it some direction."
Traders were looking at key resistance at Wednesday's high of $220.50 and then Tuesday's low of $222.00. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
